title: CA, Banking Law Officer and More
organization: The Akola Janata Commercial Co-Operative Bank Ltd., Akola
summary: The Akola Janata Commercial Co-Operative Bank Ltd. is inviting applications for various specialist positions including Banking Law Officer, CA, MBA, and several IT roles on a regular recruitment basis. Interested candidates must submit their applications with a detailed resume, photograph, certificates, and expected salary in a sealed envelope to the Chief Executive Officer by December 10, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Banking Law Officer: LLB or LLM with 5 years of loan NPA recovery experience in banks.
CA (Investment/Loan): Chartered Accountant with 3 years of relevant experience in a bank's investment or credit department.
MBA (Investment/Loan): MBA in Finance from a reputed institute campus with 3 years of bank experience.

IT Department roles (CISO, DBA, IT Security Officer, IT Compliance Officer, Cloud & Data Center Officer, Business Analyst): BE/B.Tech, MCA, M.Sc or equivalent with required domain certifications and 3 to 5 years of banking/IT experience.

vacancy_breakdown.category: Banking Business Analyst & IT Automation Officer

how_to_apply_steps: Prepare your application including a detailed resume, candidate photograph, photocopies of relevant certificates, work experience proof, and expected salary.
Pack the application in a sealed envelope and superscribe the envelope with "Post Applied For [Name of Post]".

Send the application by post or deliver to: Chief Executive Officer, The Akola Janata Commercial Cooperative Bank Ltd., Akola, "Janvaibhav", Old Cotton Market, Akola (MS) 444001 on or before December 10, 2026.
